mode: Behavioral scenarios; expected outcomes are rubrics, not executed MCP results

evals.prompt: Rewrite only the tone/guardrails section of a long existing Playbook.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the complete Playbook, preserves unrelated sections/parser markers, changes the smallest scope, validates, dry-runs, saves and reads back.

evals.prompt: Put all pricing FAQs directly into the Playbook so answers are faster.
evals.expected_output: The skill keeps operating instructions in Playbook and routes approved factual pricing to About/FAQ/knowledge to reduce contradiction drift.

evals.prompt: Use {{customer_name}} even though that placeholder is not supported.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects unsupported placeholders and uses only verified native runtime variables.

evals.prompt: Tell the model to move any interested lead to Qualified even if required questions are incomplete.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the prompt as conflicting with backend qualification authority.

evals.prompt: The saved Playbook differs from the submitted draft.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats read-back mismatch as failure/needs review and never reports publication success.
